experiments.scope: 128-byte SHA3-r6,768-free-bit prefix family and neutral lanes4/14;512 messages and18-bit mask, layout k6r6-bs-full-width. Maintains975 A2 words with492-word polarity and499 affine patches. First batch compiles all32 physical hot leaves one at a time and applies each twice, checking A2,O2P and256 keys;31339..31378 static operations with explicit spill/reload and table/control accounting. Dedicated physical cold audit checks decoding,equal/distinct/future/maximal ids,64-register restore and cap; forced hot/cold branches check integration. Direct sponge,dependency poisoning,two transpose and tagged-table diagnostics remain. Organizer isolation only; no prior execution result for this package. Scaled evidence cannot prove H1 or the full attack.
experiments.hypothesis: As heuristic H1 predicts, the masked digests of the grouped prefix message set behave like independent uniform18-bit values: success frequency agrees within sampling error with approximately0.3931 for512 messages. Its ratio512^2/2^18=1 is approximately matched to the full-run ratio(255/256)^2=0.9922027587890625, not identical.
